description:
Uploads one or more commercial invoice files for a consignment (for international shipments).
Files are provided as base64-encoded content.

Args:
  - consignmentId (number): The consignment to attach the invoice to
  - files (array): Array of files, each with fileName and fileBase64 content
name: machship_upload_commercial_invoice

errors.description: Validation errors returned by Machship, if any

object.description: Response payload from the Machship API

title: Upload Commercial Invoice
